title: Benko Gambit: the main line
line: For the pawn, Black's queen, rooks and bishop all bear down on White's queen's side.

steps.text: The Benko Gambit, as in the ideas lesson.
Black takes back with the bishop, and White builds the center.
Black trades bishops, so White's king has to take back and cannot castle.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. Once your knight moves, it aims at White's queen's side.
steps.after: White tucks its king away by hand.

steps.text: Castle, to get your king to safety.
Bring the other knight out. It clears the back rank for your rooks.
Bring the queen out on the open file. It presses on the knight on c3.
Now put the other rook on the second open file.
steps.after: Queen, rooks and bishop all bear down on White's queen's side.

summary: For the pawn, Black's queen, rooks and long bishop press on the queen's side, where White's pawns are hard to guard.
